messages:
marie: Quick sync — I posted the first draft of the FY25 goal portfolio and company-level OKRs. Need alignment on the three top-level company objectives, plus launch criteria for Dedicated v2 and Private VPC. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.internal/fy25-goals PTAL. Goal: finalize by Fri EOD so we can publish to the whole company.

sam: Saw the doc. Quick question on latency SLOs for Dedicated v2 — you have 95th < 150ms for 8k tokens. That seems aggressive given current kernel coverage.

alex: I think we should be pragmatic — set GA SLO at 95th < 200ms for 8k tokens, with a stretch target of 150ms for the common 2k token case.

rachel: To hit consistent 150ms we'd need additional kernel optimizations + extra A100 capacity for the pool. Estimate ~6 weeks of eng work and a monthly infra delta (~$XXk). Can we phase the work?

ben: Cost is the blocker from finance. If Dedicated reserves bump cost by ~25% for the same throughput, sales will need a clear upsell path or committed customers. Need a short cost appendix.

marie: Proposal: phased rollout. GA: 95th < 200ms (8k), publicly documented SLOs, and opt-in beta w/ pricing uplift for customers who require 150ms 8k. Launch criteria (draft):
- Perf: perf harness shows SLO met across representative traffic and model variants.
- Reliability: canary run at 10% traffic for 2 weeks with <1% error and no repeated SLO breaches.
- Compliance: private/VPC checklist + DPA/KMS sign-offs.
- Docs: migration guide, pricing sheet, and runbook.

alex: Add acceptance criterion: during canary, must validate fallback behavior (automatic model-variant fallback) and no increase in customer error budget > 1%.

sam: We'll need a concrete perf timeline. I can target a prototype kernel improvement in 3 weeks, then a 2-week performance validation. Also: we need a fallback routing policy implemented before canary.

rachel: I'll own the runbook and rollback hooks. I'll also capture capacity and cost delta numbers.

marie: @nina can you confirm legal & compliance timing for the Private VPC DPA updates?

nina: Need to update DPA and KMS language; I can turn that around in ~3 business days if no major changes. Will flag anything blocking.

ben: Finance OK in principle with phased pricing, but I need the cost appendix and projected uplift ARR scenario to greenlight the reserve spend.

taylor: Sales will prepare messaging and pilot outreach. We need final uplift pricing by Wed to start pilot comms.

alex: Action items recap:
- marie: update doc with phased launch criteria & timeline.
- sam: perf timeline + fallback policy draft.
- rachel: runbook + capacity/cost numbers.
- nina: DPA/KMS updates.
- ben: provide finance go/no-go criteria once cost appendix lands.
- taylor: sales messaging and pilot list.

marie: I'll consolidate updates and circulate a final sign-off packet by Thu COB. Final sign-off sync Fri 10:00am PT. Please react with :white_check_mark: in-thread when you're aligned or drop quick objections here.

sam: :white_check_mark:

alex: :white_check_mark:

rachel: :white_check_mark: will add runbook in the doc by EOD tomorrow

nina: :white_check_mark: starting DPA edits today

taylor: :white_check_mark: prepping pilot list

ben: I will review the cost appendix when marie posts it and follow up with the numbers.

marie: Thanks — if nothing else, I'll take the :thumbsup: as tacit alignment. I'll ping again when the packet is ready.
